The title of '''despot''' was held by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] during his reign over [[Xim's empire|his empire]] starting in [[25,130 BBY]]. He was defeated and dethroned in the [[Third Battle of Vontor|third battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vontor]] against the [[Hutt Empire]] in [[25,100 BBY]], after which he [[Death/Legends|died]] in captivity. [[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] later, during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="Atlas" /> the volume that contained the [[Lyrre T'enna's annotated field guide|field guide]] of [[Zoologist/Legends|zoologist]] [[Lyrre T'enna]] stated that some despots were viewed with contempt throughout the [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|history]] maintained in [[ionic journal]]s and on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]].<ref name="Wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>
